span.p:
Message Queue (Kafka/SQS)
At-least-once delivery.
Producers: write async (PA/EL).
Consumers: process idempotently.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
External API (Payment Gateway)
Always PC/EC — payments must be
strongly consistent and idempotent.

Cache (Redis/Memcached)
TTL-based invalidation.
Always PA/EL — cache is never strongly
consistent in multi-node deployments.
